root_cause: Skipped required-test lanes were counted as orchestration waste even when their execution cost is zero. Daily tuning also could increase concurrency/speculation on thin or missing timing observations, with no cooldown to observe the result.
failureModes: skipped lane ratio incorrectly reduces parallel work
repeated optimistic adjustments before post-change observation
prevention: measure observed job and required-run sample counts
exclude skipped jobs from runtime-pressure heuristic
hold upward tuning until sufficient observations and cooldown
retain all safety gates and protected release checks

evaluation.baseline_comparison: Previous tuner treated skipped_rate > 0.35 as orchestration waste; revised tuner does not.
evaluation.success_metric: At least 20 sampled jobs with adequate timing samples; no optimistic retune within 30 hours; shorter or equal p95 time-to-live on comparable changes
evaluation.rollback: revert candidate commit through protected change if post-release CI p95 or failure rate deteriorates
